metadata.author: HunterToon Team
metadata.description: Asura Scans English manga/manhwa source (Astro.js SSR). Homepage at /; browse at /browse?page=N; detail at /comics/{slug}; reader at /comics/{slug}/chapter/{num}; images on cdn.asurascans.com. Supports locked chapter detection.
metadata.changelog: v1.1.0 (studied against live site): (1) FIX pagination/browse: the real server-rendered listing is /browse/comics?page=N (verified: 40 cards/page, page 1 != page 2); plain /browse?page=N returns an empty client-side shell, which is why the list never advanced. Homepage page>1 and filtered browse now use /browse/comics?page=N; genre/type filters try /browse/comics?genres=..&page=N first and fall back to the plain listing if the server returns no cards (filters are client-side/API only). (2) FIX search: /browse?search= is also a client-side shell; search now calls the site API api.asurascans.com/api/search?q= (returns {data:[{slug,title,cover|cover_url,type}]}), mapping slug to /comics/{slug}. (3) FIX intermittent chapter images: cdn.asurascans.com intermittently drops non-browser HTTP clients (verified: our IP was TCP-blocked while the site kept serving browsers and weserv fetched the CDN fine); chapter images now go through images.weserv.nl with output=jpeg (serves any client, no webp decode issues). List/detail/chapter-list logic unchanged.
